access: The user mentions a problem with login.
usability: The user mentions the layout of the app.
playback: The user mentions a playback failure.
The user mentions the app crashing.
The user mentions a connection failure.
catalog: The user mentions searching for music.
billing: The user mentions being forced to pay for premium features.
The user mentions a payment problem.
The user mentions premium failing to activate.
support: The user mentions contacting customer support.
other: This text is general feedback about the app.

intent.cancellation: This person wants to stop using the app or cancel their subscription.
intent.complaint: This text expresses a negative experience or criticism.
intent.request: This text requests a new feature or an improvement.
intent.praise: This text expresses a positive opinion.
intent.unclear: This text is unrelated to using the app.

severity.1: There is no reported problem: the text is praise, neutral, unclear, or only a feature request.
severity.2: The user reports dislike or annoyance but does not report losing any functionality.
severity.3: The user reports that some app features are restricted or not working properly.
severity.4: The user is unable to use the app at all.
5: The user reports that money was stolen from their account.
The user reports that their private information was exposed.
The user reports that their personal data was permanently lost.

sentiment.negative: The user expresses a negative opinion.
sentiment.neutral: The user expresses a neutral opinion.
sentiment.positive: The user expresses a positive opinion.
